response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT sf.zoneref AS zoneref, sf.articount AS articount, CAST(sf.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM scanfeatures sf, t WHERE sf.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.articount AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
